newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's SFE wheat futures fall on rain.
newsitem.headline: Australia's SFE wheat futures fall on rain.

text.p: Most Australian wheat futures quotes on the Sydney Futures Exchange fell on Tuesday in reaction to a continuation of the planting rain in Australia's eastern wheat belt that began on the weekend.
"On the settlements, the market was off quite heavily," Chris Gray of C,A & L Bell Commodities Corp Pty Ltd said.
But actual trades were limited to January 1998 futures which fell A$2 a tonne to A$183 on a volume of 18 50-tonne lots.
Gray said the rain had encouraged farmers and traders into some hedging. Settlement prices declined by a range of A$3 to A$5 in the September 1997 to September 1998 contracts.
